create.name: Laura Plumb
create.bio:
Laura Plumb teaches the Vedic sciences of Ayurveda and Jyotish (Vedic astrology), with mantra and meditation woven through both. She came to this work after a period of grief and loss in her younger years led her first to meditation, then to yoga philosophy, Vedic cosmology and Ayurveda, a path she has now followed for more than four decades. Before teaching full time she ran The Discovery Channel in Europe. She trained at the American Institute of Vedic Studies and the Kerala Ayurveda Academy, has studied Jyotish with several Western teachers of the tradition, founded VedaWise, and wrote the cookbook Ayurveda Cooking for Beginners.

Today most of her teaching is online. She reads birth charts in one-to-one Jyotish consultations, offers longer spirit counselling that draws on chart work, self-enquiry and meditation, and records classes on the planets, the lunar mansions known as nakshatras, and the gods, gems and flowers linked to each planet. Her Ayurveda teaching ranges from short introductory classes and seasonal resets to a professional nutrition training for practitioners. She also shares guided meditations drawn from the Upanishads and the Navratri devotions to the Divine Mother, and posts talks on her YouTube channel.

courses.title: Jyotish Life Reading
courses.description: A first one-hour Vedic astrology consultation on Zoom, looking at your natal chart, your moon's nakshatra, current transits and planetary period. Questions about work, relationships, moves or spiritual practice can be brought in.

courses.title: Spirit Counsel
courses.description: A run of at least three one-to-one sessions combining chart work, Vedic counselling, self-enquiry and meditation. The aim is to see the story you are living now and find room for creativity and freedom in it.

courses.title: Jyotish Fundamentals – Power of the Planets
courses.description: Eight recorded classes, over twenty hours in all, on the planets, signs and houses of Vedic astrology and how they relate, with PDF notes for each and a bonus class on the lunar nodes. You also learn to read a chart for yourself.

courses.title: The Moon & Her Stars
courses.description: A class series on the twenty-seven lunar nakshatras of Jyotish. Every class gives a mantra, a meditation, journal prompts and practices for working with that nakshatra; single classes are sold separately too.

courses.title: Class: Gods, Goddesses, Gems & Flowers
courses.description: A recorded class of about two and a half hours on the archetypes, gems, flowers and plants linked to each planet in Jyotish. It covers which suit a given chart and how to use them alongside mantra and devotion.

courses.title: The Song of Your Birth Star
courses.description: A personal booklet prepared from your birth details, naming your nakshatra, its seed sound and ruling planet, with a mantra for you to recite. It arrives by email within about ten days.

courses.title: Course: Devi Sadhana
courses.description: Nine recordings for the nine nights of Navratri, each with a story of the Divine Mother as Durga, Kali, Lakshmi or Saraswati, her mantras, and a chanting meditation.

courses.title: Class: Living Ayurveda – An Introduction
courses.description: A two-hour recorded beginners' class on the five elements, the three doshas and the twenty qualities of nature, and how to use them in everyday choices.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditation: Remembrance of Self
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation built from favourite verses of the Upanishads, read as a quiet invitation back to your own deeper self. Sent by email after sign-up.

free_resources.title: Your Free Jyotish Chart
free_resources.description: A free tool on her site that draws your Vedic birth chart from your birth date and place, with her notes on how to read the houses, signs and nakshatras.
